Your case data is not affected: it is stored by the browser and in your .bsdata file, not inside this HTML.

2

Risk and threat intelligence report

For businesses and individuals.

Subject and purpose

Identifiers prevent confusing the subject with someone of the same name. Findings matched on the name alone are reported but never rated.

Individuals: this assessment excludes special categories of personal data.
Legal basis and proportionality

Recorded in the case audit log before any search runs.

Standards applied
  • Legality, necessity and proportionality: declared purpose and lawful basis; only what the purpose requires is collected.
  • Identity resolution: every finding records how it was matched; name-only matches are never rated.
  • Provenance: every source must be a page returned by this run's searches.
  • Grading: source reliability (A–F) and information credibility (1–6), provisional for the analyst to confirm.
  • Facts, judgements, confidence, alternatives and intelligence gaps are kept apart.
  • Risk level computed from likelihood × impact on a fixed 5×5 matrix, never taken from the model.
  • Excluded: special categories of personal data, children, closed or leaked material; exposed personal data is described, not reproduced.

Script Analyzer

Static analysis of scripts and configuration files — no execution required

Security Notice — Read Before Use
  • Never run or execute any script obtained from an investigation target — use this tool instead.
  • Any URL fetch triggered by this tool makes a real network request. Use a VPN or Tor first.
  • If analyzing malware or active threat actor infrastructure, the fetch will signal your presence. Confirm before fetching.
  • Scripts may contain obfuscated payloads. AI analysis is probabilistic — always verify findings manually.
  • Do not paste scripts containing credentials, tokens, or personal data into the AI analysis field.
Best Practices for Script Investigation click to expand
Before you start:
  • Confirm your VPN or Tor is active before fetching any external URL.
  • Use a dedicated investigation profile or VM — not your personal browser.
  • Document the source URL, acquisition timestamp, and chain of custody before analyzing.
During analysis:
  • Run static extraction first — it costs nothing and reveals most IOCs immediately.
  • Use the knowledge base guidance before invoking AI to avoid unnecessary API costs.
  • Treat every URL, IP, and domain extracted as a potential IOC — pivot from them.
  • Base64 blobs should always be decoded — they frequently conceal secondary payloads.
Platforms covered: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket (public repos), Docker Hub manifests, raw URLs, pasted content. Private repos: paste content manually — never store tokens in this tool.

Image Intelligence

Reverse image search, facial recognition, and visual verification — open source only

Legal: Facial recognition tools may be restricted in your jurisdiction. Confirm lawful basis before use. Results from PimEyes and FaceCheck require interpretation — false positives are common.
Reverse Image Search
Paste an image URL below, then launch the engines you want. To search a local file, click Upload local file — the app copies the image to your clipboard and opens Google Lens; paste it there with Ctrl/Cmd+V (or drag the file in) to search. Alternatively host the file first via Google Photos, Google Drive, ImgBB or Postimages to get a public URL.
Local file — opens Google Lens with file upload

With a URL pasted, click any tool in the cards below to search with it.

Exact Copy Detection
TinEye
Best for finding exact copies and modified versions. Indexes 60B+ images.
Google Images
Broadest index. Use "Search by image" → paste URL. Good for context.
Yandex Images
Best for facial recognition and Eastern European/Russian sources. Often finds matches Google misses.
Bing Visual Search
Strong on product images and stock photos. Unique index from Microsoft.
Baidu Images
China’s largest image index. Good for sources and copies from Chinese-language sites.
Face Search
PimEyes [free tier limited]
Best free facial search engine. Shows where a face appears online. Upload direct.
FaceCheck.id [free tier]
Free facial recognition search across social media and public web.
Yandex (face)
No account needed, best results for Slavic and European faces.
Video Verification
InVID / WeVerify
Browser extension. Keyframe extraction, reverse video search, metadata. Industry standard for journalists.
YouTube (latest)
Sort by upload date to find first occurrences of events/footage.
Investigator Tips

Faces: Always use Yandex first — no account needed and it consistently outperforms Google for biometric matching.

Context: Run the same image through 3+ engines. Different indexes surface different history.

Video frames: Use InVID to extract keyframes, then reverse-search each frame individually.

Deepfakes: Use Deepfake Detector and Sensity for synthetic media detection.

 Before you start

        
Most tools are Python: install Python 3.9+, then pipx (python -m pip install --user pipx then pipx ensurepath) and use pipx install <tool> so each lives in its own environment. Subfinder, Amass and PhoneInfoga are Go binaries (go install …); ExifTool ships as a system package or a standalone .exe. These commands run from your machine and contact targets directly — use a VPN or Tor for hostile or sensitive investigations.

TLP 2.0 — TRAFFIC LIGHT PROTOCOL (CISA / FIRST)

                

                  

                    TLP:CLEAR
                    No restrictions. Information can be shared publicly. Use when data carries minimal risk of misuse.
                  

                  

                    TLP:GREEN
                    Community sharing. Share with peers and partners within your community. Not via public channels. Default for sector-wide awareness.
                  

                  

                    TLP:AMBER
                    Limited disclosure. Share within your organisation and clients on a need-to-know basis. Carries risk if shared outside involved organisations.
                  

                  

                    TLP:AMBER+STRICT
                    Organisation only. More restrictive than AMBER — do not share with clients. Internal need-to-know only.
                  

                  

                    TLP:RED
                    Named recipients only. Do not share with anyone beyond the specific meeting, conversation, or exchange. Highest sensitivity.
                  

                

                
Source: CISA TLP 2.0 / FIRST Standard (adopted November 2022). TLP is not a formal classification scheme — it governs sharing permissions, not legal obligations.

 OPSEC & Dark Web

        
Operational security guidance and dark web intelligence resources

      


      

        
        
Legal Notice: Accessing .onion services may be restricted in your jurisdiction. Ensure you have lawful authority before investigating dark web resources. For journalists: consult your legal team first.

      


      

        

           Your connection
        

        

          Furgaris does not change how you connect. It runs with whatever VPN, proxy or Tor setup you already have, and
          research you carry out is attributable to that connection. Before sensitive work, check how you appear to a
          target: apparent IP and country, whether your DNS matches, and whether your exit range is recognisable.
        

         Check your connection
        

          VPN, Tor and translation options are listed under Links of Interest → Privacy & Tooling. Furgaris neither
          endorses nor audits them.
        

      


      


        
        

          

             Pre-Investigation OPSEC Checklist
          

          

          
        


        
        

          

             Recommended OPSEC Tools
          

          

            
              

              
Tor Browser
Route traffic through the Tor network. Required for .onion access.

            
            
              

              
Tails OS
Amnesic live OS — leaves no trace on the computer after shutdown (RAM is wiped). Includes Tor Browser, MAT2, and secure communications tools. Note: your ISP still sees that you connected to Tor.

            
            
              

              
Whonix
Two-VM architecture: a Workstation VM with no direct internet access, routed through a Gateway VM that runs Tor. Even if the Workstation is compromised, it cannot leak your real IP — it only knows the Gateway.

            
            
              

              
Mullvad VPN
No-logs VPN with audited privacy policy. Accepts cash and Monero. Useful to hide your Tor usage from your ISP — but note: the Tor Project advises against combining VPN with Tor unless you understand the risks (see torproject.org/support).

            
            
              

              
Dangerzone
Converts untrusted documents to safe PDFs in an isolated container. Essential for opening dark web files.

            
          

        


        
        

          

             Dark Web Search Engines
            ⚠ REQUIRES TOR BROWSER
          

          

            

              

                
Ahmia

                
Indexed, safe search — filters known abuse content. Also has a clearnet version.

              

              

                 .onion
                 Clearnet
              

            

            

              

                
Torch ⚠ UNFILTERED

                
One of the oldest dark web search engines. No content filtering — results may include CSAM, illegal marketplaces, malware. Investigators should preview from a sandboxed Tor session. Verify the .onion address from a trusted current source before use — phishing clones are common.

              

              

                 .onion
              

            

            

              

                
Haystak

                
Commercial dark web search engine. Free tier for keyword search; paid Pro tier adds Boolean operators, date filters, deeper results. Large claimed index.

DuckDuckGo (Onion)

                
DuckDuckGo's onion service. Searches the clearnet privately from inside Tor — does not index .onion sites, but useful for OSINT pivots without leaving Tor.

           Version Information
        

        

          

            Furgaris v3.0

            Released: July 2026 | Built by Albert Planas
          

          

            Furgaris is a privacy-first, offline OSINT investigation platform designed for journalists, 
            security researchers, and investigative professionals. It provides structured access to 166+ public 
            OSINT resources across 14 intelligence domains without compromising operational security.

               Third-Party Service Dependency

              launch interface only—it does not control, verify, or guarantee the accuracy, availability, or 
              reliability of any external service.
            

          


          

            

               No Guarantee of Accuracy
            

            

              OSINT data sources may contain outdated, incomplete, or inaccurate information. Always verify 
              findings through multiple independent sources. Do not make critical decisions based solely on 
              data obtained through this tool.
            

          


          

            

               User Responsibility for Legal Compliance
            

            

              You are solely responsible for ensuring your use of this tool and any OSINT techniques comply with 
              all applicable laws, regulations, and ethical guidelines in your jurisdiction. This includes but is 
              not limited to:
            

            
    
              
  • Data protection and privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
    •

    • 
              
  • Terms of service of third-party platforms
    • 
              
  • Professional codes of conduct
    • 
              
  • Investigative journalism ethics
    • 
            

          


          

            

               Account & API Key Requirements
            

            

              Some OSINT services require user accounts, API keys, or paid subscriptions for full access. 
              Furgaris provides links to these services but does not include or manage authentication 
              credentials. Consult each service's terms before creating accounts.

Furgaris is provided free of charge and "AS IS", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to the warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, and non-infringement. You use this tool entirely at your own risk.

          


          

            

               Not Legal Advice
            

            
Nothing in Furgaris — including any AI-generated report, suggested legal reference, or framework mapping — constitutes legal advice. All outputs are drafting aids that must be reviewed and validated by a qualified professional before any official, evidentiary, or legal use.

          

        

      


      
      

        

           Privacy & Data Handling
        

        

          

             Zero Data Transmission
          

          
    
            
  • All operations performed locally in your browser
    • 
            
  • No analytics, telemetry, or tracking of any kind
    • 
            
  • No servers, databases, or external logging
    • 
            
  • Search queries never leave your device
    • 
            
  • Investigation logs stored locally only (localStorage)
    • 
          


          

             External Links
          

          

            When you click search buttons, this tool opens external OSINT services in new browser tabs. 
            Once you visit those sites, their own privacy policies and terms of service apply. 
            Furgaris has no control over or responsibility for external site behavior.
          


          

             Optional AI Features
          

          

            If you choose to use AI synthesis features with your own Anthropic API key, data is transmitted 
            to Anthropic's servers under their privacy policy and terms of service. This is entirely opt-in 
            and not required for core functionality.

 Avisos legals importants

          

            

              
 Dependència de serveis de tercers

              
Aquesta eina depèn de serveis i bases de dades OSINT externs de tercers. Furgaris actua només com a interfície de llançament — no controla, verifica ni garanteix l’exactitud, la disponibilitat ni la fiabilitat de cap servei extern.

Les fonts de dades OSINT poden contenir informació desactualitzada, incompleta o inexacta. Verifica sempre les troballes mitjançant múltiples fonts independents. No prenguis decisions crítiques basant-te únicament en dades obtingudes amb aquesta eina.

            

            

              
 Responsabilitat de l’usuari en el compliment legal

              
Ets l’únic responsable d’assegurar que el teu ús d’aquesta eina i de qualsevol tècnica OSINT compleixi totes les lleis, reglaments i directrius ètiques aplicables a la teva jurisdicció. Això inclou, entre d’altres:

 Requisits de comptes i claus API

              
Alguns serveis OSINT requereixen comptes d’usuari, claus API o subscripcions de pagament per a l’accés complet. Furgaris proporciona enllaços a aquests serveis però no inclou ni gestiona credencials d’autenticació. Consulta les condicions de cada servei abans de crear comptes.

Furgaris es proporciona de manera gratuïta i «TAL QUAL», sense cap mena de garantia, expressa o implícita, incloent-hi, sense limitació, les garanties de comerciabilitat, idoneïtat per a un propòsit concret, exactitud i no-infracció.  No és assessorament jurídic

Totes les sortides són ajudes de redacció que han de ser revisades i validades per un professional qualificat abans de qualsevol ús oficial, probatori o legal.

            

          

        


        

          
 Privadesa i tractament de dades

          

            
 Cap transmissió de dades
